comments.value:
Although we greatly appreciate posts where you've detailed out several ideas, please separate these items into individual items! We don't permit "omnibus" or "batch" posts on our Feedback boards. 

Thank you!

details:
1. Toggle Vive front camera to see play space. I would love to work on homework while also be playing VRChat at the same time. 

	2. Have descriptions for players so you know when you became their friend and maybe where (like which world you friended them). 

	3. Have a feature that allows VRChat players to take voluntary surveys from their menu so that VRChat can have more analytical data and player feedback. Perhaps make it to where it can even link to the VRChat icanny. 

	4. Have tutorial worlds. I still absolutely love the idea to have tutorial worlds. Tutorials to make avatars, worlds, and other content. 

	5. Have an online profile for VRChat users where they can link to Twitter, Paypal, Artstation, Linkedin, Youtube, Discord, and any other related links or social media. Have the player be able to pull up their profile, in-game. 

	6. Have a small spawnable tablet, like the VRChat camera, in which you can enter text, show one's desktop, or play online url links for other players. 

	7. Have an in-game rating system where players can rate other players. The voting system doesn't show the number value of the person if they are voted positive or voted negative. Depending on this undisclosed number variable, they will receive a symbol beside their name. If it's positive, it will show a thumbs up, smily face, or a heart. The heart means the person has a 100% positive feedback rating. If it's negative, there will be a thumbs down, a sad face, and a skull if they are rated negative. The rating feature doesn't show directly on the hud but when the player highlights the other player (it's in the same visual hud as showing if an avatar is optimized). 

	8. Improve driving mechanics for all VR systems in-game (driving with the vive is near impossible), perhaps provide with examples of functional vehicles in the SDK. 

	9. Set a screen-fader or "sleep mode" in the game's system menu for people who want to sleep in VR.
	
Virtual market related ideas: 
	10. Have a new menu feature (much like enabling the camera) where players can spawn items instead of using gestures or emotes on avatars. This could open a items to be commodity in a future virtual market. 

	11. Another idea I had relatable to the commodity of items and accessories in a virtual market is to allow avatars to have socketed/ attachable items which they can pull off of their person. 

	12. If VRChat were to make a virtual market system, it would be interesting to also have a category where there are free items for purchase every month like Unreal's market place and perhaps Steam's marketplace.
title: 12 new and interesting ideas for VRChat
